name: realesr-general-x4v3
purpose: 「变清晰」：在本机把图片放大 2 倍或 4 倍（全面方案第 26 件）

source.architecture: SRVGGNetCompact(num_in_ch=3, num_out_ch=3, num_feat=64, num_conv=32, upscale=4, act_type='prelu'), realesrgan/archs/srvgg_arch.py

onnx.output: output: float32 [1, 3, height*4, width*4], RGB, clamp to 0..1
onnx.converterTools: Python 3.13, numpy 2.5.5, onnx 1.23.2; self-check with onnxruntime 1.32.0

runtime.licenseNote: onnxruntime-web and onnxruntime-common on npm ship no license or notices file. Both files are copied unmodified from the official onnxruntime 1.31.1 wheel on PyPI (onnxruntime/LICENSE and onnxruntime/ThirdPartyNotices.txt), the same version as the npm packages.
